card.summary: BASIC (free) account: 1 GB storage, 100 MB / 500 pages max per document, unlimited number of publications, 5 private publications.

free_tier.stated: BASIC (free) account: 1 GB storage, 100 MB / 500 pages max per document, unlimited number of publications, 5 private publications.

egress.terms: Flipbook viewing is free and unmetered for readers, but there is no direct-download of the original on the free tier; the service reserves the right to requote at "2,500 publications or 1,000,000 reads per month" (its own industrial-scale threshold).

record.tooling: No public upload API on BASIC; conversion is browser-driven. No rclone/WebDAV/SFTP.
record.chaining: 1 GB/account x unlimited accounts = technically repeatable but 1 GB units with a 100 MB/file cap make 10 TiB == 10,240 accounts. Not viable.
record.limits_note: 1 GB total storage; 100 MB / 500 pages per document; 5 private publications; 1 administrator; 1 folder; 2,500-publication / 1M-read threshold triggers a commercial requote.
record.reliability_note: Free tier storage is 1 GB. Document processing errors may occur on large PDF uploads.

evidence.proved: 'The User of a BASIC Account enjoys the following advantages: - Storage: 1 GB - Maximum document size: 100MB and 500 pages - Private Publications: 5'
